# Moosend

Moosend is a cloud-based, AI-powered email marketing solution that allows you to target your audience at scale.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/moosend/.

## Actions

- **Add or Update Subscriber**: Add or update a subscriber in a mailing list.
- **Create custom field**: Create a custom field in a mailing list.
- **Create Mailing List**: Create a new empty mailing list in moosend.
- **Delete Campaign**: Delete a campaign.
- **Delete custom field**: Remove a custom field definition from a mailing list.
- **Delete Mailing List**: Delete a mailing list.
- **Get all campaigns**: Retrieve a list of all campaigns in your account.
- **Get All Subscribers**: Retrieve subscribers in a specified mailing list by status.
- **Get Campaign Details**: Retrieve detailed properties of a specific campaign.
- **Get Subscriber By Email**: Search for a subscriber by email in a mailing list.
- **Schedule Campaign**: Schedule a campaign.
- **Send Campaign**: Send an existing draft campaign immediately.
- **Update Campaign**: Update a draft campaign.
- **Update custom field**: Update properties of an existing custom field in a mailing list.
- **Update Mailing List**: Update the properties of an existing mailing list.
